  • Method Details

    • createCustomList

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CustomListResponseDTO> createCustomList(String userId, CustomListRequestDTO requestDTO)
      Creates a custom list for a specified user based on the provided request data.
      Parameters:
      userId - The unique identifier of the user for whom the custom list is to be created.
      requestDTO - The data transfer object containing the details for the custom list, including title, description, privacy settings, tags, and cover image URL.
      Returns:
      A ResponseEntity containing a CustomListResponseDTO with details of the created custom list, or a bad request response if the user does not exist.

    • getCustomListById

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CustomListResponseDTO> getCustomListById(String listId, String currentUserId)
      Retrieves a custom list by its unique identifier and checks access permissions for the current user.
      Parameters:
      listId - the unique identifier of the custom list to be retrieved
      currentUserId - the unique identifier of the currently authenticated user
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a CustomListResponseDTO if the list is found and accessible;

    • updateCustomList

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CustomListResponseDTO> updateCustomList(String listId, String userId, CustomListRequestDTO requestDTO)
      Updates an existing custom list with new data provided in the request. Validates the list ID, user access, and updates the information based on the request details.
      Parameters:
      listId - The unique identifier of the custom list to be updated.
      userId - The ID of the user who is attempting to update the custom list.
      requestDTO - The data transfer object containing the updated details for the custom list.
      Returns:
      A ResponseEntity containing the updated custom list data if successful. Returns a 404 status if the list is not found or a 403 status if the user is not authorized.

    • deleteCustomList

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deleteCustomList(String listId, String userId)
      Deletes a custom list identified by the given list ID if it exists and the user has permission to do so. The method first checks whether the list exists. If the list does not exist, a 404 Not Found response is returned.
      Parameters:
      listId - the unique identifier of the custom list to be deleted
      userId - the unique identifier of the user requesting the list deletion
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity with a status code based on the result:

    • getUserLists

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<CustomListResponseDTO>> getUserLists(String userId, String currentUserId)
      Retrieves the lists associated with a user. If the requesting user is the owner of the lists, all lists are returned. Otherwise, only public lists are returned.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user whose lists are being retrieved
      currentUserId - the ID of the currently authenticated user making the request
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a list of CustomListResponseDTO objects if the user exists, otherwise a 404 (not found) ResponseEntity

    • getPublicLists

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<org.springframework.data.domain.Page<CustomListResponseDTO>> getPublicLists(int page, int size, String sortBy)
      Retrieves public lists with pagination and sorting options.
      Parameters:
      page - the page number to retrieve, zero-indexed
      size - the number of items per page
      sortBy - the sorting criteria; "popular" for sorting by likes and updated date in descending order, or "recent" (default) for sorting by updated date in descending order
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a paginated list of CustomListResponseDTO objects

    • searchLists

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<org.springframework.data.domain.Page<CustomListResponseDTO>> searchLists(String query, int page, int size)
      Searches for public custom lists based on a query string, with pagination support.
      Parameters:
      query - the search query to filter custom lists by their title
      page - the page number to retrieve in the paginated result set
      size - the number of items per page in the paginated result set
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a Page with the matching CustomListResponseDTO objects

    • addMovieToList

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CustomListResponseDTO> addMovieToList(String listId, String movieId, String userId)
      Adds a movie to a custom list specified by the list ID. Verifies if the movie and list exist and checks if the user is the creator of the list before adding the movie.
      Parameters:
      listId - the ID of the custom list to which the movie should be added
      movieId - the ID of the movie to be added to the list
      userId - the ID of the user attempting to add the movie to the list
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity<CustomListResponseDTO> containing the updated custom list if the process is successful, or an error response entity if the operation fails

    • removeMovieFromList

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CustomListResponseDTO> removeMovieFromList(String listId, String movieId, String userId)
      Removes a movie from a custom list based on the provided list ID and movie ID. Validates if the list and movie exist, and verifies the user's authorization to modify the list before performing the removal.
      Parameters:
      listId - the unique identifier of the custom list
      movieId - the unique identifier of the movie to be removed from the list
      userId - the unique identifier of the user attempting to remove the movie
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a CustomListResponseDTO if the operation is successful,

    • addSeriesToList

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CustomListResponseDTO> addSeriesToList(String listId, String seriesId, String userId)
      Adds a series to a custom list if the list and series exist, and the user is authorized to modify the list. Returns the updated custom list.
      Parameters:
      listId - the unique identifier of the custom list
      seriesId - the unique identifier of the series to add to the list
      userId - the unique identifier of the user performing the operation
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing the updated CustomListResponseDTO if successful, or an appropriate HTTP status if the operation fails

    • removeSeriesFromList

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CustomListResponseDTO> removeSeriesFromList(String listId, String seriesId, String userId)

      listId - the unique identifier of the custom list from which the series is to be removed

      a ResponseEntity containing a CustomListResponseDTO if the operation is successful,

    • toggleLike

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CustomListResponseDTO> toggleLike(String listId, String userId)
      Toggles the like status of a custom list for a specified user. If the custom list is private, only the creator of the list is permitted to like or unlike the list.
      Parameters:
      listId - the unique identifier of the custom list whose like status is being toggled
      userId - the unique identifier of the user performing the like/unlike operation
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a CustomListResponseDTO with the updated custom list details and the current like status for the user

    • addComment

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<ListCommentResponseDTO> addComment(String listId, String userId, String content)
      Adds a comment to a custom list. Ensures the user and the list exist, and validates if the user has permission to comment on the specified list.
      Parameters:
      listId - the identifier of the custom list to which the comment is to be added
      userId - the identifier of the user adding the comment
      content - the content of the comment to be added
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a ListCommentResponseDTO of the saved comment if successful, or an appropriate response status if the operation fails

    • getComments

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<ListCommentResponseDTO>> getComments(String listId, String currentUserId)
      Retrieves the comments for a specified list. This method checks if the list exists and verifies if the current user has access to the comments.
      Parameters:
      listId - the unique identifier of the list for which comments are to be retrieved
      currentUserId - the unique identifier of the current user making the request
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a list of ListCommentResponseDTO objects representing the comments if successful, or an appropriate error status
